newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares seen mixed after Monday slide.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares seen mixed after Monday slide.

text.p: Chilean shares were expected to hold steady after retreating late Monday on profit-taking and losses on the Sao Paulo bourse, brokers said.
"People are going to wait and see what the mood overseas is like. I don't think you'll see too many big trades in the morning," said one broker.
The blue-chip IPSA index ended 0.63 percent down for the day Friday at 133.82 points, and the general IGPA index was off 0.28 percent to 5798.73 points.

Central Bank President Carlos Massad said just before the market opened that he believed economic growth in May, as measured by the Imacec index, will stand at a healthy five percent or more but that inflation targets remained on track.
The Imacec figures and latest foreign trade numbers are due to be released on July 23.
